pending_verification.claim: Lap-cost measurement can now produce a usable sample.
pending_verification.changed: scripts/window-roll.mjs — resets_at compared with a 5-minute tolerance instead of string equality.
pending_verification.why: The collector re-derives resets_at every call, so one unmoved weekly window reported .314Z/.180Z/.968Z/21:59:59.937Z across 12 consecutive collections on 2026-08-09. String equality called that a reset. Laps spanning a collection died as window_reset_mid_lap; laps not spanning one died as no_new_usage_reading. Together those cover every lap, so 6 of 6 samples were unusable and no cost was ever measured.
pending_verification.not_yet_verified: No usable sample has been observed since the fix. Do not call this fixed until one exists.
pending_verification.indicator: state/automations.json shows avg_cost_percent != null with samples >= 1 for eta-loop, and scripts/pacing.mjs stops printing UNMEASURED default for it.
pending_verification.if_still_unmeasured: The remaining killer is no_new_usage_reading: laps shorter than the collection interval compare a reading to itself. Next move would be to have the lap read usage directly at both ends rather than waiting on the hourly commit.
